title: Use the line primitive
heading: Put the algorithm behind one command.
description: A drawing primitive is a basic building block for a picture. Our workshop provides line(x1, y1, x2, y2): give it a start pixel and an end pixel, and it runs Bresenham for you. line(0, 0, 7, 3) draws the staircase you just explored. Change an endpoint to try another direction.

scene.title: Your picture · 8 × 5 enlarged pixels
scene.label: An enlarged 8-column, 5-row pixel picture. Whole cells are shaded; x counts right from 0 to 7 and y counts down from 0 to 4.

completions.description: Draw a line made of pixel cells

feedback.empty: Your program ran. Add pixel(...) or line(...) to colour your picture.
feedback.drawn: You can now draw a whole line with one call. Next, repeat many lines to make a surprising pattern.
